name: oie-web-administrator
description: Web-based administrator for Open Integration Engine (Mirth Connect fork). Standalone NodeJS app that mirrors the Swing Administrator and is pluggable by extension developers.

scripts.prestart: node tools/build-info.mjs && node tools/build-vendor.mjs && node tools/build-core.mjs && node tools/build-server.mjs
scripts.predev: node tools/build-info.mjs && node tools/build-vendor.mjs && node tools/build-core.mjs && node tools/build-server.mjs
scripts.build: node tools/build-info.mjs && node tools/build-vendor.mjs && node tools/build-core.mjs && node tools/build-server.mjs && vite build && node tools/build-plugins.mjs && npm run gen:types
scripts.gen:types: tsc -p tsconfig.types.json && cp client/core/oie-schema.d.ts ../packages/web-api/types/oie-schema.d.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.types-shell.json && cp client/core/oie-schema.d.ts ../packages/web-shell/types/oie-schema.d.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.types-ui.json && cp client/core/oie-schema.d.ts ../packages/web-ui/types/core/oie-schema.d.ts
scripts.test: for f in client/core/*.test.js server/*.test.js; do node "$f" || exit 1; done
